newsitem.title: USA: Golden Ore in talks on $100 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Golden Ore in talks on $100 mln financing.

text.p: Golden Ore Inc, a gold mining exploration company based in London, said Wednesday it has reached an agreement in principle in which a major investor would infuse $100 million into the company.
The company said that if the recapitalization deal is completed, the current majority shareholder would increase its stake to 95 percent, from 62 percent.
It said the number of outstanding shares would increase to 400 million, from 49.6 million, but the publicly floated shares would remain unchanged.
The company said the proposed deal would result in net proceds of $90 million.
"Although there can be no assurance that it can be consummated, or on what terms in may finally be concluded, the company is optimistic that it will occur within the next 28 dsays," it said.
Fabio Pannuti, chief executive, said by telephone from London that the closing of the deal was "imminent," but declined to provide other details.

He said in the company's announcement, however, that "strong caution is recommended given the fact that negotiations can always break down at any stage of any transaction and no one is immune from othis considreation.

The company said that assuming the recapitalization closes, Golden Ore proposes to buy producing or near-producing "hard rock" assets and obtain the services of gold mining industry professionals to be in the company's board.
